tasks.check: deno fmt --check deno.json README.md src tests scripts examples grammar && deno lint src tests scripts && deno check --unstable-webgpu src/cli.ts tests/*.test.ts scripts/*.ts && deno task rust-wasm:check
tasks.rust-wasm:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust-wasm-emitter/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust-wasm-emitter/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --locked -- -D warnings && deno run --allow-read --allow-run=cargo scripts/build_rust_wasm_emitter.ts --check
tasks.release:gpu: deno task check && deno task test && deno run --unstable-webgpu --allow-read scripts/release_gpu.ts
tasks.duck:grammar: deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/import_ducklang_grammar.ts grammar/ducklang-tree-sitter-grammar.json grammar/duck.baba && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/update_duck_conflicts.ts grammar/duck.baba grammar/duck.baba.json && deno fmt grammar/duck.baba.json && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/generate_baba_parser.ts ducklang grammar/duck.baba grammar/duck.baba.json grammar/generated
tasks.duck:contract: deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/import_ducklang_contract.ts ../binned/examples/manifest.ts examples/binned/contract.json && deno fmt examples/binned/contract.json
tasks.zero:grammar: deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/generate_baba_parser.ts zero grammar/zero.baba grammar/zero.baba.json grammar/zero-generated
